description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Heronblade Elite.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Heronblade Elite.
Repeat.

uses.name: Heronblade Elite
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
